definitions.explanation: A sword made of wood, used for practice in kendo and other martial arts. Also sold as souvenirs at tourist spots.

examples.japanese: ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{木刀|ぼくとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: We use wooden swords in kendo practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}→修学旅行：05590_shuugakuryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{木刀|ぼくとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a wooden sword as a souvenir on the school trip.

examples.japanese: {木刀|ぼくとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: Wooden swords are made of wood, but they hurt when they hit you.

notes:
{木刀|ぼくとう} is a practice sword made of wood, used primarily for martial arts training in ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧ and other ⟦{武道|ぶどう}→武道：09640_budou⟧. It is formed from {木|ぼく} (wood) + {刀|とう} (sword).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木刀|ぼくとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{素振|すぶ}り→素振り：29965_suburi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to practice swings with a wooden sword
- {木刀|ぼくとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ — to swing a wooden sword
- {木刀|ぼくとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ — to hold a wooden sword at the ready

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{竹刀|しない}→竹刀：27833_shinai⟧ — bamboo sword (used in kendo sparring)
- ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧ — Japanese sword; katana
- ⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧ — real sword (also means "serious")

CULTURAL NOTE:
Buying a {木刀|ぼくとう} is a classic souvenir for Japanese students on school trips, particularly to historical sites like Kyoto or Nara.
